title: Human Remote Onboarding
subtitle: A 30-day experience that helps new teammates feel useful sooner

slides.title: The first-week gap
slides.content: New teammates need confidence and context before they can contribute meaningful work.

bullet_points.title: Make belonging visible
bullet_points.description: Create a clear human welcome before the first task.

bullet_points.title: Reduce uncertainty
bullet_points.description: Show where questions go and what good progress looks like.

bullet_points.title: Build early momentum
bullet_points.description: Give every new teammate one useful contribution to own.

slides.title: Design the first 30 days
slides.content: A repeatable rhythm turns onboarding from a checklist into a shared experience.

bullet_points.title: Week one
bullet_points.description: Build relationships, vocabulary, and an accessible map of the work.

bullet_points.title: Weeks two and three
bullet_points.description: Pair guided practice with an increasingly real piece of work.

bullet_points.title: Week four
bullet_points.description: Reflect together and agree on the next level of ownership.

slides.title: One shared signal
slides.content: Measure whether people feel equipped to make a useful contribution, not just whether tasks were assigned.

bullet_points.title: Ask early
bullet_points.description: Check confidence after the first week, while changes still matter.

bullet_points.title: Look for behavior
bullet_points.description: Notice when new teammates initiate work and seek the right help.

bullet_points.title: Improve the system
bullet_points.description: Use each cohort’s feedback to sharpen the next welcome.
